title: "Lucky Beach House" in Panama City Beach | Coast Property Management – Coast Properties
meta_description: "Lucky Beach House" in Panama City Beach | Coast Property Management
description_expanded: Welcome to “Lucky Beach House” — your 6 Bedroom, 6 Bathroom Gulf-front getaway in Panama City Beach. LOCATION: Lucky Beach House is ideally located in the exclusive Bid-A-Wee community of Panama City Beach. Enjoy unobstructed views of the Gulf from the three king bedrooms, living room, and front balcony. You will be mere steps from the home’s private, deeded-access beach - almost half a mile of private Gulf beach front. Enjoy peaceful coastal living while still being only a 5-minute drive from Pier Park and its abundant shopping, dining, and entertainment options. PROPERTY OVERVIEW: 1st Floor Features: Owner Suite 1: King bed, private bathroom with walk-in shower - Gulf views Owner Suite 2: Queen bed, private bathroom with walk-in shower - Gulf views Owner Suite 3: Queen bed, private bathroom with walk-in shower - Gulf views Owner Suite 4: Queen bed, private bathroom with walk-in shower Bedroom 5: Bunk beds (2 x twin) 2nd Floor Features: Floor-to-ceiling Gulf-view windows Fully stocked kitchen with spacious island and bar seating Extendable dining table with additional breakfast bar seating Bonus Sleeping Room: Two twin beds (please note: this room does not have a window) Living area with large smart TV Access to balcony with breathtaking ocean views Office space area with chair and desk Separate seating nook off the main living room area Other Features: Fully fenced-in private pool All suites some with smart TVs Private driveway parking for two cars Laundry room with full-size washer and dryer AMENITIES: To enhance your stay, we also provide a starter supply of premium, eco-friendly guest essentials, including: Body Wash, Shampoo & Conditioner Hand Soap, Dish Soap & Dishwasher Pods Toilet Paper, Paper Towels & Facial Tissues ️ Trash Bags & Dish Sponge Laundry Detergent GUEST SUPPORT: Need assistance? Coast’s dedicated management team is available to help with anything you need—just give us a call! IMPORTANT NOTES: Age Requirement: The primary guest must be 25 or older to book. Parking: The home comes with driveway parking for two cars. Check-In Policy: Please do not arrive before your scheduled check-in time. No Pets & No Smoking: This home has a strict no-pet policy. Unauthorized pets will result in immediate eviction and loss of rental fees, with the guest responsible for any damages. The home is also strictly non-smoking.

Cleanliness: All towels and bedding washed in hot water that's at least 60ºC
